pr_title: sql: enable by-ID and by-name references to tenants
pr_body:
Fixes #89967

tldr: multiple changes
- new `WITH tenant_name` clause of `RESTORE TENANT` to set the
  tenant name and ID auto-allocation (auto-allocation is skipped
  if `WITH tenant` is also specified.
- most TENANT SQL syntax can refer to tenants by-name or by-ID.
- `TestServer` can start tenant servers either by-name or by-id.
- builtin `rename_tenant` was removed.
- new syntax form `DROP TENANT ... IMMEDIATE`.
- builtin `destroy_tenant` was deprected in favor of `DROP TENANT [IMMEDIATE]`.


----

Prior to this patch, certain tenant controlling statements were
allowing the user to refer to tenants by numeric ID; whereas others
were referring to tenants only by name.

This commit fixes this by introducing a consistent syntax:

- by default a name is expected;
- if the user wants to refer to a tenant by ID, they can include
  the ID between square brackets. This is consistent with
  other uses of square brackets to refer to tables/databases.

| Statement                                 | Before       | After        |
|-------------------------------------------|--------------|--------------|
| `DROP TENANT <t>`                         | by-name only | both         |
| `CREATE TENANT <t>`                       | by-name only | by-name only |
| `CREATE TENANT <t> FROM REPLICATION OF`   | by-name only | by-name only |
| `CREATE TENANT FROM REPLICATION OF <t>`   | by-name only | by-name only |
| `SHOW TENANT <t>`                         | by-name only | both         |
| `SHOW TENANT <t> WITH REPLICATION STATUS` | by-name only | both         |
| `ALTER TENANT <t> PAUSE REPLICATION`      | by-name only | both         |
| `ALTER TENANT <t> RESUME REPLICATION`     | by-name only | both         |
| `ALTER TENANT <t> COMPLETE REPLICATION`   | by-name only | both         |
| `ALTER TENANT <t> SET REPLICATION`        | by-name only | both         |
| `ALTER TENANT <t> SET CLUSTER SETTING`    | by-ID only   | both         |
| `ALTER TENANT <t> RESET CLUSTER SETTING`  | by-ID only   | both         |
| `ALTER TENANT <t> RENAME TO`              | N/A          | both         |

Additionally, the RETENTION option to CREATE TENANT / ALTER TENANT now
accepts any INTERVAL value, not just strings.

Additionally, it now supports removing the name of a tenant via the
functions `crdb_internal.rename_tenant()` and the new `ALTER TENANT
RENAME TO` statement.

Additionally, it modifies RESTORE TENANT to rename the target tenant,
to avoid name conflits.

Additionally, it makes TestServer able to start a tenant server
designated either by name or by ID.

Release note: None
Epic: CRDB-18749
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/94932)
@adityamaru @lidorcarmel you probably want to learn about this.

:thinking_face: I'm wondering if we really want CREATE TENANT to be able to use an ID.  While it would allow us to support CCs current usage without a crdb_internal builtin, is that worth exposing this ability more generally? We don't allow users to choose the IDs of other objects.

> I'm wondering if we really want CREATE TENANT to be able to use an ID. While it would allow us to support CCs current usage without a crdb_internal builtin, is that worth exposing this ability more generally? 

Ok - let's not do it.

This PR has been iterating for long enough as it is. Merging now; we can add fixups in followups.

bors r=stevendanna

issue_context.title: streamingest: make the name of the target tenant customizable
issue_context.body:
as part of the UA work we are giving names to tenants.  (#89966)

Currently in `streamingccl > streamingest >  stream_ingestion_planning.go` the TenantInfo of the new target tenant is created with no name.

It is important that this name becomes customizable, for example as an extra parameter in the SQL syntax.

cc @adityamaru @stevendanna for triage.

Jira issue: CRDB-20522

Epic CRDB-18749
